title: (RHEA-2017:3130) CDK 3.2.0 release
portal_summary: Red Hat Container Development Kit 3.2.0 has been released.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Container Development Kit|3.2|x86_64
portal_solution: To start using CDK, download it from https://access.redhat.com/downloads/content/293/ and follow the instructions provided in the Red Hat Container Development Kit Getting Started Guide linked from the References section.
portal_description:
Red Hat Container Development Kit is a platform for developing containerized applications — it is a set of tools that enables developers to quickly and easily set up an environment for developing and testing containerized applications on the Red Hat Enterprise Linux platform.

Red Hat Container Development Kit 3.2.0 brings a number of bug fixes, improvements, and new features, including OpenShift Container Platform 3.6, support for user profiles and, as a Technology Preview, the ability to run the Che integrated development environment.

See Red Hat Container Development Kit 3.2 Release Notes and Known Issues linked from the References section for more details.
